name: Kub Mnemoziny
source:
My name is left behind white walls. In its place, I have dozens of questions. I wander at random, though she seems to lead me. I do not feel safe. Twenty-four hours... Everything will fall into place.

[From [url=https://freql.itch.io/mnemosynes-cube]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我的名字被留在白墙后面。取而代之的是，我有几十个问题。我随意漫步，但她似乎在引领我。我感觉不安全。二十四小时……一切都会水到渠成。

[来自[url=https://freql.itch.io/mnemosynes-cube]Itch.io[/url]]
